 Pacers star Pascal Siakam & philanthropy leader Dakota Whyte discussion at IU Indianapolis
 Free event on Nov. 12 highlighting their impact on sports, philanthropy, and education 
 --> 
 Oct 26, 2026 
 Hub icon -->
 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 --> 
 Pascal Siakam discusses sports and philanthropy. 
 Indiana Pacers Forward Pascal Siakam and former professional athlete Dakota Whyte will join the Mays Family Institute on Diverse Philanthropy at the IU Lilly Family School of Philanthropy for a public discussion on Thursday, Nov. 12, at IU Indianapolis. 
 Titled “Beyond the Game,” the conversation will explore how athletes can leverage athletic success to drive long-term philanthropic and educational impact. Hosted at Hine Hall on the IU Indianapolis campus, the event begins with a networking reception at 4:30 p.m., followed by the discussion at 5 p.m. The event is free and open to the public, though registration is requested.
 During the discussion, Siakam and Whyte will share the mission and origin of the PS43 Foundation, which empowers youth through education, life skills, and mentorship. Siakam established the foundation during his tenure with the Toronto Raptors, inspired by his late father, Tchamo Siakam, a passionate advocate for education. The organization’s name carries deep personal meaning: the “4 “represents his father and three brothers, while “3” represents his mother and two sisters.
 From his upbringing in Douala, Cameroon, to NBA stardom, Siakam’s journey reflects his commitment to creating transformative opportunities for the next generation of youth leaders.
 Whyte, Executive Director of the PS43 Foundation, brings a deep background in sports and social impact. A former Division 1 standout at the University of Wisconsin, Canadian Youth Olympian, and professional basketball player, Whyte brings extensive experience in sports and social impact. She previously led community engagement and sports branding initiatives at Nike and holds an MBA from Toronto Metropolitan University.
 Event Details: 
 Date & Time: Thursday, November 12, 2026 | Reception: 4:30 p.m. | Program: 5 p.m.
 Location: Hine Hall, IU Indianapolis (850 W. Michigan St., Indianapolis, IN)
 Admission: Free and open to the public. Registration 
 ###
 Sports and Philanthropy Initiatives from the Mays Family Institute 
 The Mays Family Institute on Diverse Philanthropy has several initiatives that provide research-based, practical instruction to athletes and leaders of sports organizations. The institute prepares them to use their philanthropic activities and enhanced leadership skills to have a positive impact across society and demonstrate how sports can pave the way to a better future.
 About the Indiana University Lilly Family School of Philanthropy 
 The Indiana University Lilly Family School of Philanthropy at IU Indianapolis is the world’s first and only school dedicated solely to the study and teaching of philanthropy. The school offers a comprehensive approach to philanthropy through its undergraduate , graduate , certificate and professional development programs, its research and international programs and through The Fund Raising School, Lake Institute on Faith & Giving, the Mays Family Institute on Diverse Philanthropy and the Women’s Philanthropy Institute. For more information, visit philanthropy.indianapolis.iu.edu .
